pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions; multi-tier entries authorized only when existing open position has achieved at least +$2.50 floating profit and moved past the initial breakeven volatility buffer.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory integration of a 5-period ATR volatility envelope check; no order execution permitted if current spread plus ATR noise exceeds 15% of the intended risk boundary.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop-loss activation once positions reach +$3.00, locking in baseline gains while letting asymmetric runners scale toward +$15.00-$30.00.
